name: IPSO-10031 Repro - Jinja2 Cast Type Mismatch
description: Reproduction workflow for IPSO-10031: TemplateBuilder.renderJinja2TemplateWithCast declares its 'renderedTemplate' output as type 'object' in pronghorn.json regardless of the selected castDataType, even when castDataType is set to 'string' and the runtime genuinely returns a plain string (see cog.js). Wiring that output into WorkFlowEngine.ViewData's 'body' field (declared type 'string') reproduces the Canvas false-positive type-mismatch warning described in the ticket.

a1.name: renderJinja2TemplateWithCast
a1.summary: Render Jinja2 Template With Data Cast (castDataType=string)
a1.description: IPSO-10031 repro task: renders a Jinja2 template with castDataType explicitly set to 'string'. Declared outgoing schema for 'renderedTemplate' is hardcoded to type 'object' in pronghorn.json regardless of castDataType.

b2.name: ViewData
b2.description: IPSO-10031 repro task: consumes Task a1's 'renderedTemplate' output (declared object, actually a string at runtime) in the 'body' field (declared string).
